development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude Code (CLI) with the model Claude Sonnet 5.5 (as in the commit attribution) wrote the code, tests and drafts of the documents. CLI version and tool settings: not-exportable (not recorded). To confirm by the author.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: No plugin or extension shaped this work. To confirm by the author.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: App model gpt-6-luna (OpenAI Responses API through PydanticAI 2.54.0). temperature 0, max_tokens 1000, openai_reasoning_effort medium, retries 0, timeout 60 s. Two calls: the draft and the support check. Each call is saved in model_call with its settings.

skills.notes: Eight user-level skills shaped the work. See the configuration records. The author copies the skill folders into ai-workflow/skills/ before hand-in.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: Kept outside the repository: AGENTS.md (two documentation links for the agent), the specs and ticket files (tasks/) and the design notes (.notes/). The author decides what to publish, so .gitignore lists AGENTS.md, tasks/ and .notes/. A coordinator session handed each ticket to a subagent that ran the do-work-ticket skill.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: Scripts: make checks, make record, make reset, make start, make types. No hook was set up. To confirm by the author.

prompts_and_rules.notes: SYSTEM_PROMPT and SUPPORT_SYSTEM_PROMPT are the prompts of the app. domain.md holds the supplied business rules and was not changed.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: No MCP server or tool setting was needed for this exercise. To confirm by the author.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: Only names are in the repository: MODEL_MODE, OPENAI_API_KEY, MODEL_NAME, DB_PATH. The .env file is ignored by Git. Claude Code permission settings: default, not exported.
